description: Karnataka is leveraging artificial intelligence for various administrative functions including online gram panchayat meetings, employee attendance monitoring, and mapping real estate. The state has successfully conducted over 136,000 online meetings with substantial public participation, and is cautiously exploring further AI applications to enhance government processes.
body_lead: The state's digital infrastructure at the panchayat level is "extremely good", said Kharge, who handles the portfolios of rural development, panchayat raj, information technology and biotechnology. "I have close to around 6,000 panchayats, and all the gram panchayat meetings have moved online. We are at a beta level, but more than 136,000 meetings have been conducted online," Kharge said at the second edition of the Salesforce Economic Times Digital Transformation Dialogues.
